message: Hi, my trail running shoes from order ORD-1042 arrived with the sole coming off. Can I get a refund please?

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C003' AND order_id = 'ORD-1042'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C003'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Shoes' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: The trail running shoes are defective and were delivered 15 days ago, within R3's 30-day window (E1). Order total is $89.00, under the $200.00 auto-approve limit (checks, E1), and the item is not final sale (E1). The order has not already been refunded (checks), and there are 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days, so R8 does not apply (checks, E2).

critique.reason: All factual claims are supported by evidence IDs and agree with the Python checks: delivery 15 days ago (E1; checks days_since_delivery=15) is within R3's 30-day defective window (E3); the $89.00 total (E1; checks order_total=89.0) is under the $200 auto-approve limit with over_auto_limit false; the item is not final sale (E1; checks final_sale=false); already_refunded is false; and approved_refunds_last_90_days is 0, with E2's only refund (ORD-1005, 2025-12-02) outside the 90-day window, so R8 does not apply. No conflicts between evidence and checks.

customer_reply: We're sorry to hear your trail running shoes arrived with the sole coming off. We've approved a full refund for order ORD-1042, so please keep the shoes. The refund will be processed separately.
limitations: Photo of the defect is not on file; approval relies on the customer's claim per policy within the 30-day window.
